restaurantName: Pescarino-Sapori di Terra e di Mare
bio: Warm and inviting atmosphere with wooden walls and ceiling. The kitchen, recently renovated alongside the terrace, remains unchanged in offering: relatively simple in some concoctions, more creative in others, aiming primarily to highlight the product quality, predominantly seafood, with Ligurian nuances but extending to other regions. Considering the isolated location, seizing the opportunity to rest in the rooms may be worthwhile....
